text:
incident-bot: Pager: Elevated 5xx rate detected on inference-gateway (us-west-2). Alert ID: INF-GW-5XX-1758. >10% increase vs baseline, starting 2025-06-12T15:20:00Z :rotating_light:
ben: oncall here, looking now. pinging infra + prod.
ben: can someone check envoy admin /config_dump and current route weights? suspect retry policy churn after yesterday's router tweak.
luis: grabbing logs from frontdoor pods. seeing a lot of repeated upstream resets -> 502/504 spike. sample log: `upstream reset: connection termination` on host inference-svc-2.
maya: graph from observability: p95 latency up to 1.2s, 5xx rate spike to 3.1% from 0.2%. errors are gateway-error and 502s.
kat: support: receiving customer reports of timeouts (esp. enterprise acct RedwoodHealth). notifying customers with incident banner.
tom: product: what's the blast radius? which routes/backends?
rachel: initial triage: a recent route patch introduced `retry_policy` shadowing + aggressive retries on 5xx. That plus circuit-breaker low max_connections created retry-amplification.
ben: do we have the config id? luis, can you pull xDS snapshot?
luis: pulling: `kubectl -n infra exec -it xds-control -- curl -sS http://localhost:8080/snapshot | jq '.routes | select(.name=="inference-gw")'` -> route config version `v2025-06-12-11`. snippet of problematic stanza:
```
retry_policy:
  retry_on: "5xx,gateway-error"
  num_retries: 3
  per_try_timeout: 2s
shadow_policy:
  enabled: true
```
maya: also found circuit_breakers settings on cluster `inference-backend` with `max_connections: 100` and `max_pending_requests: 50` - lots of client retries are piling up and exhausting connections -> upstream starts returning 502.
ben: ok immediate mitigation options: 1) turn off retries at gateway to break amplification, 2) bump circuit breaker thresholds, 3) scale backend quickly, 4) rollback route patch v2025-06-12-11. Which is fastest?
luis: fastest is flip retry_policy to `none` via a hotpatch on xDS and disable shadowing. can push a small config delta and trigger envoy reload.
deploy-bot: Deploy CI check: xds hotpatch candidate `hotfix/disable-retries-1758` validated against schema. Ready to apply if approved.
ben: do it. apply hotpatch to prod us-west-2 only (limit blast radius).
luis: applying now: `curl -X POST http://xds-control.apply/snapshots -d '{"target":"inference-gw","patch":"disable-retries"}'` -> 202 Accepted. pushing to envoys in us-west-2.
maya: watching metrics... starting to see 5xx rate trending down within 30s. p95 latency trending down too.
kat: customer comms updated: "We are investigating increased timeouts and have applied an emergency mitigation. We'll update once stable."
ben: confirm we didn't leave any retry shadowing elsewhere? run grep over config repo.
luis: confirmed: legacy test routes had shadowing on, disabled globally for inference-gw in us-west-2 by hotpatch.
rachel: follow-up: need to increase `max_connections` to 800 on `inference-backend` cluster to avoid recurrence and investigate why one backend host was overloaded.
tom: prioritize rollback of v2025-06-12-11 in staging and create test for retry amplification. Also add regression eval.
ben: second-order effect: some clients were seeing duplicate requests because retries triggered upstream work twice. we should estimate customer impact.
kat: support: RedwoodHealth saw ~4% error rate for 20 minutes, they reported failed inference requests during their peak. CS notified and offered retry logic workaround for SDK.
ben: metrics snapshot at peak: total requests 1.2M in 20m window; 5xx ~36k (3%). Estimated impacted requests ~36k. Major customers: RedwoodHealth (sensitive), Adaloft (saw degraded throughput).
maya: action items: 1) postmortem owner = ben, 2) increase circuit breaker and connection pool sizes (luis), 3) add canary test for retry policy changes (rachel), 4) add automated detection for retry-amplification patterns (maya).
luis: creating PR to bump `max_connections` and `max_pending_requests`, will stage to canary and then prod once validated.
deploy-bot: Hotpatch applied successfully to 12 envoy nodes in us-west-2. Version diff: removed `retry_policy` + disabled `shadow_policy`.
maya: monitoring shows sustained drop to baseline 5xx ~0.25% at +4 minutes. p95 returned to ~250ms.
ben: handing off to next oncall for follow-up (tom will own bridging with product + cs). I'm going offline in 10m.
tom: taking handoff. will coordinate postmortem and customer follow-up.
kat: I'll follow up with RedwoodHealth and provide them a mitigation summary + timeline.
rachel: please include config diff in postmortem and link to the xDS snapshot for the rollback.
ben: final note: don't merge retry-policy changes without a canary that measures amplification. treat `retry_on: 5xx` as hazardous by default.
incident-bot: Incident INF-GW-5XX-1758 status: mitigated -> partial resolution. Assigned: ben for postmortem. Severity: Sev2.
bene: thanks team :thumbsup: closing thread, moving to #postmortems.
